Remark
[Consequences of the Gauss-map estimate]1. ch16:16.102\group chapter-16 The estimate (16.101) implies

egin{equation} ag {16.102} | u (X)- u ( ar X)|\le 2^\alpha C(|X- ar X|/R)^\alpha \end{equation}

for all $X, ar X\in \mathscr G_{R/4}(Y)$. If $K'=0$ and $\Omega =\mathbb R^2$, letting $R o \infty $ shows that $ u $ is constant.
